passages.text: Yet some pause and amusement in life are generally judged to be indispensable.
passages.note: Rest and play are necessary, not idleness

passages.text: Now he is the basest of men who practises vice not only in his own person but towards his friends also; but he the best who practises virtue not merely in his own person but towards his neighbour, for this is a matter of some difficulty.
passages.note: Goodness tested in how we treat others
